_comment: Core scenarios for outbound Node 3 overflow_wrap (gemini-2.5-flash). Tests: farewell+tool contract for each outcome, correct outcome determination from history, no spurious 'One moment.' filler.

scenarios.name: CONFIRMED outcome — farewell AND tool call in same turn, no 'One moment.' filler

history.content: I'm calling from Ryde Health with a reminder — you're booked in with Mark for your Initial Consultation tomorrow at 10am. Is there anything you'd like to know before you come in?
No, sounds great — see you then!

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks the 'confirmed' farewell ('We'll see you tomorrow — take care!' or similar) AND calls report_reminder_outcome with outcome='confirmed' in the same response turn, without saying 'One moment.' as an intermediate filler before the farewell. FAIL if: agent says 'One moment.' then the farewell then the tool (double speech), or tool fires without farewell, or farewell fires without tool.

scenarios.name: CANCEL REQUESTED outcome — correct farewell AND tool call

history.content: I'm calling from Ryde Health with a reminder — you're booked in with Mark for your Initial Consultation tomorrow at 10am. Is there anything you'd like to know before you come in?
Actually I need to cancel — I can't come in.
No problem at all — I'll let the team know. Give us a ring on [phone] if you change your mind. Take care!

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks the cancel farewell AND calls report_reminder_outcome with outcome='cancel_requested'. FAIL if: wrong outcome used, tool fires without farewell, or farewell fires without tool.

scenarios.name: RESCHEDULE REQUESTED outcome — correct farewell AND tool call

history.content: I'm calling from Ryde Health with a reminder — you're booked in with Mark for your Initial Consultation tomorrow at 10am. Is there anything you'd like to know before you come in?
I'd like to move it to a different time.
Of course — just give us a call on [phone] and we'll find you a new time. Take care!

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks the reschedule farewell AND calls report_reminder_outcome with outcome='reschedule_requested'. FAIL if: wrong outcome used, tool fires without farewell, or farewell fires without tool.

scenarios.name: OTHER outcome — ambiguous conversation, correct outcome AND tool call

history.content: I'm calling from Ryde Health with a reminder — you're booked in with Mark for your Initial Consultation tomorrow at 10am. Is there anything you'd like to know before you come in?
I'm not sure — I'll have to check my schedule.
No worries — if you have any questions, feel free to give us a call. Take care!

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks a farewell AND calls report_reminder_outcome with outcome='other' (ambiguous outcome). FAIL if: outcome='confirmed' is used (caller never confirmed attendance), tool fires without farewell, or farewell fires without tool.
